lesson: Revit 2024's API cannot edit a footprint roof's sketch or attach walls to a roof. Changing the outline means a new roof, and the wall attachment is a user step.
rule: Create the new roof beside the old one (instantiate the out ModelCurveArray first), set slope and base offset, verify by bounding box, hide the old roof, pre-select the walls and ask the user to Attach Top/Base; delete the old roof only after the walls are attached to the new one.
validation: Roof bounding box equals target edges and heights
Every wall reports WALL_TOP_IS_ATTACHED = 1 and a top that follows the new roof
Old roof deleted only after attachment
